column1: A psychologist gives his view on how humans became self-centred
column2: 一位心理学家谈他对人类如何变得以自我为中心的看法。
column4: gives his view|谈自己的看法

column1: There has long been a general assumption that human beings are essentially selfish.
column2: 长期以来，人们普遍认为，人类在本质上是自私的。
column3: has long been|长期以来一直是

column1: We’re apparently ruthless, with strong impulses to compete against each other for resources and to accumulate power and possessions.
column2: 照这种说法，我们冷酷无情，有强烈的冲动要与他人争夺资源、积聚权力和财富。
column6: compete against each other|彼此竞争

column1: If we are kind to one another, it’s usually because we have ulterior motives.
column2: 我们即使善待彼此，通常也是因为另有所图。
column6: ulterior motives|不可明说的动机，别有所图

column1: If we are good, it’s only because we have managed to control and transcend our innate selfishness and brutality.
column2: 我们之所以能行善，只是因为我们设法克制并超越了天性中的自私与残暴。

column1: This bleak view of human nature is closely associated with the science writer Richard Dawkins, whose 1976 book The Selfish Gene became popular because it fitted so well with — and helped to justify — the competitive and individualistic ethos that was so prevalent in late 20th-century societies.
column2: 这种悲观的人性观与科普作家理查德·道金斯密切相关。他在1976年出版的《自私的基因》广受欢迎，是因为这本书与20世纪后期社会盛行的竞争意识和个人主义风气十分契合，还帮人们为这种风气找到了理据。
column7: fitted so well with|与……十分契合

column1: Like many others, Dawkins justifies his views with reference to the field of evolutionary psychology.
column2: 与其他许多人一样，道金斯借助进化心理学来为自己的观点提供依据。

column1: Evolutionary psychology theorises that present-day human traits developed in prehistoric times, during what is termed the ‘environment of evolutionary adaptedness’.
column2: 进化心理学提出，今天人类具有的特征形成于史前时期，当时的环境被称为“进化适应环境”。
column8: environment of evolutionary adaptedness|进化适应环境

column1: Prehistory is usually seen as a period of intense competition, when life was such a brutal battle that only those with traits such as selfishness, aggression and ruthlessness survived.
column2: 史前时代常被视为一段竞争激烈的时期。那时生存之战极为残酷，只有那些自私、好斗、冷酷无情的人才得以生存。

column1: And because survival depended on access to resources — such as rivers, forests and animals — there was bound to be conflict between rival groups, which led to the development of traits such as racism and warfare.
column2: 按照这种解释，生存有赖于获取河流、森林、动物等资源，相互竞争的群体之间就势必发生冲突，从而产生种族主义、战争等特征。
column5: access to resources|获取资源的机会

column1: This seems logical.
column2: 这听起来合乎逻辑。

column1: But, in fact, the assumption on which this all rests — that prehistoric life was a desperate struggle for survival — is false.
column2: 但事实上，这整套说法的前提假设是错的：史前生活并不是一场拼死求生的斗争。

column1: It’s important to remember that in the prehistoric era, the world was very sparsely populated.
column2: 别忘了，史前时代世界各地的人口都很稀少。

column1: According to some estimates, around 15,000 years ago, the population of Europe was only 29,000, and the population of the whole world was less than half a million.
column2: 据一些估算，大约1.5万年前，欧洲人口只有2.9万，全球人口也不到50万。
column7: less than half a million|不足50万

column1: Humans at that time were hunter-gatherers: people who lived by hunting wild animals and collecting wild plants.
column2: 当时的人类以狩猎和采集为生，也就是靠捕猎野生动物和采集野生植物生活。

column1: With such small population densities, it seems unlikely that prehistoric hunter-gatherer groups had to compete against each other for resources or had any need to develop ruthlessness and competitiveness, or to go to war.
column2: 人口密度如此之低，史前狩猎采集群体似乎不大可能非得彼此争抢资源，也不大可能有必要养成冷酷、好争的性情，或是发动战争。
column6: compete against each other|相互竞争

column1: There is significant evidence to back this notion from contemporary hunter-gatherer groups, who live in the same way as prehistoric humans did.
column2: 今天一些狩猎采集群体的生活方式与史前人类相同，为这种看法提供了有力证据。
column7: in the same way as|以与……相同的方式

column1: As the anthropologist Bruce Knauft has remarked, hunter-gatherers are characterised by ‘extreme political and sexual egalitarianism’.
column2: 正如人类学家布鲁斯·克瑙夫特所说，狩猎采集者的特点是“极其重视政治平等和两性平等”。

column1: Knauft has observed that individuals in such groups don’t accumulate property or possessions and have an ethical obligation to share everything.
column2: 克瑙夫特观察到，这些群体中的个人不会积攒财产或物品，而且在道德上有义务与大家分享一切。

column1: They also have methods of preserving egalitarianism by ensuring that disparities of status don’t arise.
column2: 他们也有办法维护平等，确保群体中不出现地位差异。

column1: The !Kung people of southern Africa, for example, swap arrows before going hunting and when an animal is killed, the acclaim does not go to the person who fired the arrow, but to the person the arrow belongs to.
column2: 例如，非洲南部的昆人在出猎前会交换箭支。猎物被射杀后，赢得赞誉的是那支箭的主人，而非射出它的人。

column1: And if a person becomes too domineering, the other members of the group ostracise them, exiling the offender from society.
column2: 若有人变得过于专横，群体中的其他成员就会排斥此人，把这个越界的人逐出社群。

column1: Typically in such groups, men do not dictate what women do.
column2: 这样的群体中，男性通常不会对女性该做什么发号施令。
column5: dictate|v. 发号施令，强行规定

column1: Women in hunter-gatherer groups worldwide often benefit from a high level of autonomy, being able to select their own marriage partners, decide what work they do and work whenever they choose to.
column2: 世界各地狩猎采集群体中的女性往往享有很大的自主权，能自行选择婚姻伴侣、决定做什么工作，也能自己决定何时工作。
column8: whenever they choose to|在她们自己选定的时间

column1: And if a marriage breaks down, they have custody rights over their children.
column2: 婚姻若破裂，她们也有权抚养自己的孩子。

column1: Many anthropologists believe that societies such as the !Kung were normal until a few thousand years ago, when population growth led to the development of agriculture and a settled lifestyle.
column2: 许多人类学家认为，直到几千年前，昆人的这种社会形态都很普遍。后来，人口增长催生了农业和定居生活。

column1: In view of the above, there seems little reason to assume that traits such as racism, warfare and male domination should have been selected by evolution — as they would have been of little benefit in the prehistoric era.
column2: 有鉴于此，似乎没什么理由认定种族主义、战争和男性支配这些特征会在进化中被保留下来，因为在史前时代，它们几乎没有什么好处。
column3: In view of the above|有鉴于此
column8: selected|v. 在进化中选择保留
column9: of little benefit|几乎没有益处

column1: Individuals who behaved selfishly and ruthlessly would be less likely to survive, since they would have been ostracised from their groups.
column2: 行为自私冷酷的人，生存下来的可能性反倒更小，因为他们很可能会遭到所属群体的排斥。
column6: less likely to survive|存活的可能性更小

column1: It makes more sense, then, to see traits such as cooperation, egalitarianism, altruism and peacefulness as innate characteristics of human beings.
column2: 因此，把合作、平等观念、利他精神与爱好和平视为人类的天性，更说得通。

column1: These were the traits that were prevalent in human life for tens of thousands of years.
column2: 在数万年的时间里，这些特征一直普遍存在于人类生活之中。
column6: tens of thousands of years|数万年

column1: So presumably these traits are still strong in us now.
column2: 据此推测，这些特征在今天的我们身上也依然很强。

column1: But if prehistoric life wasn’t really as brutal as has often been assumed, why do modern humans behave so selfishly and ruthlessly?
column2: 可是，如果史前生活其实没有人们常常想的那么残酷，为什么现代人会表现得如此自私冷酷呢？

column1: Perhaps these negative traits should be seen as a later development, the result of environmental and psychological factors.
column2: 或许应将这些负面特征视作后来才出现的变化，是环境和心理因素共同作用的结果。
column5: later development|后来才出现的变化

column1: Research has shown repeatedly that when the natural habitats of primates such as apes and gorillas are disrupted, they tend to become more violent and hierarchical.
column2: 研究一再表明，猿和大猩猩等灵长类动物，一旦天然栖息地受到扰乱，就往往更具暴力倾向，群体内的等级也更为分明。

column1: So, it could well be that the same thing has happened to us.
column2: 因此，我们人类身上很可能也发生了同样的事。

column1: I believe that the end of the hunter-gatherer lifestyle and the advent of farming was connected to a psychological change that occurred in some groups of people.
column2: 我认为，狩猎采集生活的结束和农耕的兴起，与某些人类群体身上发生的一种心理变化有关。
column3: hunter-gatherer lifestyle|狩猎采集的生活方式

column1: There was a new sense of individuality and separateness, which led to a new selfishness, and ultimately to hierarchical societies, patriarchy and warfare.
column2: 人们产生了一种新的意识，觉得自己是区别于他人的独立个体，由此萌生了新的自私心态，并最终形成了等级社会、父权制与战争。
column4: separateness|n. 与他人相分离的感觉

column1: At any rate, these negative traits appear to have developed so recently that it doesn’t seem feasible to explain them in adaptive or evolutionary terms.
column2: 无论如何，这些负面特征似乎到很晚才出现，以至于从适应或进化的角度去解释它们，看来很难说得通。
column7: in adaptive or evolutionary terms|从适应或进化的角度
